title: A FRAUD loan charge-off debits the principal portion to the FRAUD expense account 13 instead of the ordinary charge-off expense account 14 (loan 15 L44, same portions as loan 7)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the FIVE-LEG journal entry a loan marked FRAUD posted when it was CHARGED OFF under the branch with NO charge-off reason, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1_INTEREST_FLAT / product 3). request.charge_off_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's charge-off transaction id 44 (externalId L44, type loanTransactionType.chargeOff): principalPortion 1000.0 -> "100000", interestPortion 30.0 -> "3000", feeChargesPortion 103.0 -> "10300", penaltyChargesPortion 10.0 -> "1000" minor units -- EXACTLY the loan-7 portions. request.charge_off_journal.fraud is the loan's observed fraud flag true. request.charge_off_journal.accounts is the same product mapping as the non-fraud vector (create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json / echo product-20-retrieve-one-response.json): loanPortfolio 6, receivable interest/fee/penalty 10, chargeOffExpense 14, chargeOffFraudExpense 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 20, incomeFromChargeOffFees 11, incomeFromChargeOffPenalty 11. expect.charge_off_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the five L44 legs in id order: JE 122 CREDIT account 6 1000.00, JE 123 CREDIT account 10 143.00, JE 124 DEBIT account 13 1000.00, JE 125 DEBIT account 20 30.00, JE 126 DEBIT account 11 113.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: when the loan is marked fraud, the principal debit moves to the chargeOffFraudExpense account (13), while the credit account and the two income debits are IDENTICAL to the non-fraud vector. It is the ONLY committed observation where the fraud flag changes the posted account: a port that ignores the loan's fraud flag and always debits the ordinary charge-off expense account 14 posts the SAME five amounts, sides and totals but the principal debit account cell moves, which is why a drive that ignores fraud dies here and survives on the two non-fraud vectors. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the merge is also observable here (interest/fee/penalty credits merge to 143.00; fee/penalty income debits merge to 113.00) but the loan-7 vector already isolates it; the zero-portion skip — every portion here is > 0; and the charge-off-reason mapping — absent from the product, and the port REFUSES it. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
